title: Blooming Groves
description: This projects adds various fruits and fruit-based mechanics such as trees, distinct fruit foods and more.
body:
Blooming Groves adds a small collection of fruit, crops, food, and mango wood blocks to Minecraft.

The mod is meant to make farming and building feel a little warmer without changing the whole game. You can grow fruit crops, collect mangoes, make new foods, and use a full mango wood set in your builds.

## Features

### Fruit and food

1. Mango
2. Dried mango
3. Cherry
4. Grapes
5. Lychee
6. Dragonfruit
7. Fruit salad

Several fruits have simple status effects when eaten, giving each one a small use beyond normal food.

### Crops

1. Cherry crop
2. Grape crop
3. Lychee crop
4. Dragonfruit crop

### Mango tree and wood set

1. Mango log
2. Stripped mango log
3. Mango wood
4. Mango planks
5. Mango leaves
6. Mango sapling
7. Stairs
8. Slab
9. Fence
10. Fence gate
11. Door
12. Trapdoor
13. Button
14. Pressure plate

## Requirements

1. Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Fabric Loader
3. Fabric API
4. Java 21

## Notes

Blooming Groves is still growing. Textures, recipes, balance, and world generation may change in future versions.

If something looks wrong or crashes, please include your Minecraft version, Fabric Loader version, Fabric API version, and latest log when reporting it.
